purpose: Fixtures for the Section 9 ablation test. Synthetic items over the real AAMC content outline. No human subject data of any kind is present here or anywhere in this test.

data_cutoff.content_outline: AAMC 'What's on the MCAT Exam?' content outline PDF, (c) 2020 AAMC; transcribed verbatim in rslib/src/transfer/outline.rs
data_cutoff.learner_model_priors: 2025-10-01 -- no source published after this date informs any parameter in tools/ablation.py
data_cutoff.learner_outcome_data: NONE. No real learner has used this product. There is no outcome dataset and no cutoff for one.

disjointness: study_deck.json ids are prefixed 'study::', holdout_probes.json ids 'holdout::'. The two sets share no id. tools/ablation.py asserts this at load time and again against the actual served log of every arm.
